cardinality_many: bounded multiplicity (min 2 / max N) where the domain implies it
composite_key_deferred: a weak entity identified by its parent plus a local ordinal
k2_inverse_functional: an IDENTITY-bearing relation (a badge/license/account that uniquely identifies its bearer — mark it identifying)
k4_oneof_enum: a CLOSED enumeration the domain fixes (statuses, grades, phases) — as an attribute with an enum value set
pk_natural: a domain identifier attribute (accession number, code, serial)
